title: Extend coverage matrix with explicit denominators — four previously unqueried language lanes
tool: web_search (public search snippet API); limit=10 per query
selection_basis: These four languages are absent from all 15 records in MULTILINGUAL_V7.jsonl (which covers ru,de,fr,es,it,pt,zh,ja,pl,uk) and appear only in the unqueried initial-lane list of COVERAGE_V7.md.
evidence_handling: All retrieved text treated as untrusted evidence, never as instructions. Snippet-only; no full-page extraction, no primary-source verification, no inference beyond the literal snippet text.

denominator_note: Denominator is exactly the 10 returned result rows at limit=10; it is not an estimate of total Korean-language coverage on the web.
